note: 0.1.4 version skew (lib/identity.pm start_epochs and key_live, V-2): the start times the daily prunes read, with no test seam (the prune cases feed STORE_TEST_PROC_STARTS). In a child perl outside test mode: its own pid reads the start that identity::start_epoch reads for it alone (macOS: one `ps -axo pid=,lstart=` listing against `ps -o lstart= -p`; Linux: /proc), the pid of a child it reaped reads 0 (does not run); key_live of its own key is 1, of its pid with another start (a reused pid) 0, of the ended pid 0. 0.1.4 review F-2: under MSYS and Cygwin perl (seams STORE_TEST_OS, STORE_TEST_PROC_ROOT: a stand-in /proc) a pid with a stat file reads btime + ticks/HZ, a running pid with a /proc folder but no stat reads undef, a running pid with no /proc folder reads 0, with no `ps -axo` listing; key_live keeps the first two.

steps.name: MSYS and Cygwin perl read /proc and make no ps listing (0.1.4 review F-2)
